title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v102
author: Sofia Patel
description: Motivation: add profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v102 to benchmark-lab to capture updated representative workload runners and surface adaptive-batching metrics for regression detection. This PR introduces profiling baselines (v102), representative workload runners for conversational multi-turn and embeddings workloads, an Airflow reporting DAG that aggregates run artifacts and uploads summary metrics to the observability pipeline, and accompanying dashboards and docs. Checklist: - [x] Add runner scripts and representative workloads - [x] Add profiling baselines YAML for v102 - [x] Add Airflow reporting DAG and export helpers - [x] Add unit and integration tests for reporting path - [x] Add nightly CI job for profiling runs - [x] Update docs and dashboards. Related: Linear ENG-1423, ENG-1589. Notes: initial CI run failed on a flaky e2e-reporting S3 upload (race condition); fixed by adding a small exponential-backoff retry helper and rerunning the job. No breaking changes expected. See files changed for high-level diff and review comments for implementation notes.
commits: Add profiling baselines v102 YAML and documentation references
Add representative workload runners: conversational and embeddings runners
Add Airflow reporting DAG (reporting_v102.py) and export helper (s3_retry_helper.py)
Add unit tests for metric aggregation and integration test for reporting DAG
Fix linting, add CI job for nightly profiling, update dashboards
review_comments: Marco Li: Please ensure the reported metric names follow the 'benchmark_lab.' prefix to avoid collisions. Also add a unit test that validates metric name normalization. Author: Updated metric names to use benchmark_lab.* prefix and added test_baselines.py coverage.

Priya Singh: Airflow DAG looks good but the backfill behavior needs to be explicit; suggest adding retries and clearer task_id naming for aggregate_reports. Author: Added retries to aggregate_reports, documented backfill semantics in docs/benchmark-lab/profiling.md.

Ethan Brooks: Found a race in the S3 upload step during e2e-reporting; requested a retry wrapper with exponential backoff. Author: Implemented s3_retry_helper.py, replaced direct upload calls, reran e2e tests.
CI Bot: e2e-reporting failed on first run (S3 eventual consistency). Rerun after fix passed.
Approval: Marco Li approved, Priya Singh approved, Ethan Brooks approved. Merge scheduled after CI green.
release_notes: Adds profiling baselines (v102), representative workload runners (conversational and embeddings), an Airflow reporting DAG to aggregate and export profiling runs, retry helper for S3 uploads, new dashboards and docs. No breaking changes.
